snippet.title: Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber | Free Balatro Collab | OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Jimbo and his friends join Vampire Survivors in our new free DLC, “Ante Chamber”! 🃏

Now you can use Balatro characters in Vampire Survivors whilst using Vampire Survivors card skins in Balatro, the ultimate indie game ship came true 💞 thank you to reddit user mranonymous24690 for kickstarting this ship many months ago

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1794680/view/527609017446434957

Vampire Survivors 1.14 Free Update is out today on Steam, PlayStation 4 & 5, Android, iOS & Apple Arcade (Online Co-Op is not available on mobile platforms currently). The update will be available on Nintendo Switch and Epic Game Store on October 31st.

🔗 Ante Chamber Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929770/Vampire_Survivors_Ante_Chamber
🔗 Ante Chamber FAQ: https://poncle.games/ante-chamber-faq.html
🔗 Online FAQ: https://poncle.games/vs-online-faq.html

Pick up your garlic & join our discord community 🧄
https://discord.gg/vampire-survivors

Check out our new poncle Games discord 🎮
http://discord.gg/RpnG5Y5JKV

🖥️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794680/Vampire_Survivors/ 
💚 Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/vampire-survivors-game-preview/9PD5BM2Z8C4L 
✨ Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/vampire-survivors-operation-guns-70050000047744-switch/
💙 PlayStation: https://www.playstation.com/en-gb/games/vampire-survivors/

Also available on Android & iOS!
